name: Granite Ringband
description: Open the exchange with a measured straight punch, the qi field already settled around the shoulders.

name: Torrent Bandarch
description: Step in a small clean arc round an incoming strike with the fists held level and still.

name: Charter Fistbar
description: Square the shoulders behind both fists and let the field settle over the forearms like a still pool.

name: Rumble Palmbar
description: Rap the brass crisply on the opponent's wrist the instant their arm commits to the strike.

name: Merciless Haymaker
description: Chain two hooks from alternate sides on one steady breath, each with qi drawn from the field.

name: Chime Handfill
description: Sweep an incoming punch wide with the forearm and strike back down the line it opened.

name: Knockout Mettle
description: Trap the opponent's elbow between both fists and hold it fixed by steady pressure from the field.

name: Knuckhavoc
description: Thrust the charged boss into one point of the guard and let the field's pressure follow it in.

name: Lot Brawl
description: Run guard, thrust and cross as one ordered sequence so each step covers the next.

name: Tempered Knuckleplate
description: Pour the full Xiantian field into one cross so its shock passes through guard and armor alike.

name: Gustknuck
description: Jab first with one fist so the other may follow like a second hawk on the same prey.

name: Might Knuckleridge
description: Spread the arms like two wings and take a quick pace to the side, keeping the fists high.

name: Aegisslab
description: Fold both fists before the throat and brow as paired hawks fold their wings against wind.

name: Overpowering Overhand
description: Snap the ring down on the opponent's knuckles to loosen a grip on a weapon or sleeve.

name: Equipoise Brassrim
description: Drive the near elbow across the body to meet a hook and let the far fist stay ready.

name: Decimating Uppercut
description: Drop from the guard with a looping hook that drives down into the ribs with both hips behind it.

name: Ringhavoc
description: Beat both fists alternately at the opponent's guard in rapid strokes, the qi renewed on every stroke.

name: Enthralling Uppercut
description: Close both fists over the opponent's lead arm and hold it pinned by the steady squeeze of the field.

name: Brawlmettle
description: Dive one shoulder as if to strike low, then lift the other fist to the head as the guard falls.

name: Rumble Handfill
description: Dive from a raised guard and land both fists in quick succession on the same spot of the guard.

name: Hogtying Brawl
description: Seize an arm between both brass fists and crush it steadily as the qi field tightens round the grip.

name: Lightning Hour Brassring
description: Vanish from the perch and reappear above the opponent in one stroke, landing both fists with falling weight.

name: Merciless Bandarch
description: Throw the straight from a deep stance so the qi gathered low rises up the arm in one pulse.

name: Ringflash
description: Glide forward on both feet without lifting them, the body riding level as water over a stone bed.

name: Thorn Studplate
description: Hold the fists cupped before the chest and catch the weight of a strike in the bowl of the arms.

name: Vengeful Hooking
description: Curve the hook in a long bend as a river turns and let the brass arrive from the side.

name: Equipoise Knuckleplate
description: Lower the forearm like a silted riverbed and let a punch slide over it and out of reach.

name: Fistbar Fortitude
description: Push both palms of the brass up and forward like a rising flood to lift the opponent's guard.

name: Mightring
description: Let the pooled qi overflow into the fist in one pulse as the straight blow lands.

name: Brassrim Devastation
description: Follow the course of the river from gentle jab through bending hook to the rush of the final cross.

name: Sanguine Overhand
description: Dam the whole field in the shoulder for several breaths, then burst it out through one cross.

name: Blaze Haymaker
description: Jab with the lead ring while the rear hand holds position as the second voice of the argument.

name: Torrent Knuckleridge
description: Slide the feet in matched steps so the stance never narrows and both fists keep their places.

name: Brassring Fortitude
description: Raise both rings in a level cover that lets the qi field hear every blow before it lands.

name: Gust Studplate
description: Knock the incoming fist aside with the ring of the near hand and reset at once.

name: Mayhem Hooking
description: Tap both of the opponent's wrists in turn so neither arm completes its swing.

name: Vengeful Ringband
description: Cross left and right in matched turn, each cross pressed forward by a pulse from the field.

name: Ringnerve
description: Receive a punch on one ring and answer instantly with the other along the same line.

name: Hoarfrost Brassring
description: Press the opponent's wrists to their own chest with both fists and hold them seated there.

name: Studruin
description: Drive the boss of the lead fist through the guard with the rear fist striking its back.

name: Hourring
description: Strike with each ring in strict turn in a sequence that never leaves one hand idle.

name: Intent Knuckleridge
description: Strike the lead arm and the shoulder in one beat so the field seals the limb against use.

name: Ringruin
description: Open on the first track with a quick jab that draws the guard toward it.

name: Studvortex
description: Step from one track to the other so the opponent's aim lags a half-beat behind.

name: Brassrim Valor
description: Hold a separate cover on each track, one fist high and one low, with qi steady in both arms.

name: Palmbar Nerve
description: Rap the ring on the track the opponent is using and knock the strike off its line.

name: Adamantine Palmbar
description: Parry outward along the track of the incoming blow and clear the line for the second fist.

name: Titanic Knockout
description: Run hooks down both tracks in alternation, each given qi so the guard cannot settle on either.

name: Chime Bandarch
description: Cut in on the track the opponent leaves open as their punch passes and strike inside it.

name: Ringdurance
description: Press one fist across the opponent's arm on one track and hold it while the other stays free.

name: Mayhem Uppercut
description: Strike the track the opponent expects to be quiet and break their rhythm in a single blow.

name: Studplate Devastation
description: Send one boss down each track to the same point so the guard has two forces to meet.

name: Intent Overhand
description: Narrow both tracks into one in a closing sequence that ends with both fists on the guard.

name: Mastering Brawl
description: Hold the opponent between the two tracks of the field and press both fists to their sides.

name: Hellish Iron Fistbar
description: Gather both tracks of qi in the shoulders over several breaths and release them in one guard-breaking blow.

name: Granite Handfill
description: Jab from the high perch with the shoulders level and the eyes on the opponent's centre.

name: Dazzling Knuckleplate
description: Rise on the toes and let a rush of qi lift the body a pace along its line.

name: Aegis Brassrim
description: Close the fists before the face like a hawk closing its wings against a stoop of wind.

name: Mayhem Fistbar
description: Tap the brass on the tip of the opponent's fingers as their hand opens to grip.

name: Ferocious Ringband
description: Climb into an uppercut with a surge of qi that lifts the opponent's chin and guard together.

name: Flintlike Brassring
description: Turn in the air of the stance as a hawk wheels and return a hook past the opponent's shoulder.

name: Mayhem Overhand
description: Press upward with both brass fists under the opponent's arms to tip their weight onto the heels.

name: Rumblering
description: Plunge from the raised guard in a downward blow that drives the full body weight through the brass.

name: Reverberating Haymaker
description: Rise, turn and plunge in a single connected sequence with the qi field following each stage.

name: Devastating Uppercut
description: Climb to the top of the stance over several breaths, then fall as one blow carrying the whole field.

name: Tempered Bandarch
description: Speak the first word of the oath and jab to give it deed.

name: Mightstud
description: Slip to the windward side of a strike so the qi field catches the air and the body moves lightly.

name: Knuckspine
description: Stand in the oath's guard with both fists raised and give no ground to the exchange.

name: Studvalor
description: Tap the opponent's wrist to turn their bearing away from you and leave the line clear.

name: Unbowed Knuckleridge
description: Flick the forearm outward like a gust and send an incoming fist past the shoulder.

name: Ringwrath
description: Chain hooks one after another as a wind drives a flame, each sworn and each given qi.

name: Murkknuck
description: Lean into the opponent's charge as into a headwind and turn it aside with a punch.

name: Fastening Knockout
description: Pin the opponent's arm with both fists and hold it as an oath is held, without loosening.

name: Tempered Hooking
description: Speak the oath aloud and throw the cross that breaks the guard to keep it.

name: Ringscourge
description: Run a sequence of sworn blows, each gathering force from the last as a gale builds.

name: Might Knockout
description: Release the field in one blow that fulfils the oath, landing with the full weight of the wind.

name: Titanic Brawl
description: Fix a bearing on the opponent across open ground and send the jab straight along it.

name: Vanishing Ringband
description: Cover ground in one long stride along the rim without losing the bearing held on the target.

name: Thorn Palmbar
description: Spread the arms in an open cover where nothing hides behind and the field takes the blow.

name: Blaze Handfill
description: Bend the hook round the wind at the rim so it lands from the side the opponent trusts.

name: Murk Knuckleplate
description: Turn the body to keep the bearing as a blow passes and strike along it in answer.

name: Fastening Studplate
description: Press both fists along the bearing against the opponent's chest and hold them in place.

name: Glint Hooking
description: Stoop from the high guard and drive a charged boss along the held bearing into the guard.

name: Doctrine Haymaker
description: Run the length of the rim in a sequence of strides and blows that never loses the bearing.

name: Flashing Knockout
description: Cross the open ground in one breath and land a charged cross before the opponent can turn.

name: Shattering Studplate
description: Throw the straight on the first gust of breath, the wind's name spoken softly as the fist leaves.

name: Granite Brawl
description: Turn on the lead foot as a gale turns a banner, carrying the body off the opponent's line.

name: Evergreen Brassrim
description: Brace the arms upright and keep the qi field firm against wind and blows alike.

name: Mayhem Brassring
description: Tap the ring on the opponent's lead hand to turn their strike off line like a puff of wind.

name: Indomitable Fistbar
description: Sweep the elbow across the body to stop a hook and keep the oath-hand ready.

name: Haymaker Scourge
description: Chain crosses faster and faster as a rising gale, each sworn in turn and each with fresh qi.

name: Chimering
description: Burst out of the guard like a squall the moment a blow passes and strike the exposed ribs.

name: Thorn Handfill
description: Drive in beneath the opponent's arms and pin them against their body with both brass fists.

name: Ringmettle
description: Seem to break the oath's line with a clumsy step, then strike as the opponent commits to it.

name: Knuckscourge
description: Drive the charged boss straight through the guard in one oath-sworn thrust.

name: Doctrine Hooking
description: Gather speed through a sequence of strikes, each quicker than the last until the final cross.

name: Nova Uppercut
description: Drive the full gale of the field into one boss point to split guard, plate and qi alike.

name: Punishing Overhand
description: Jab out from an open stance with no covering hand, trusting the field to guard the rest.

name: Slabglare
description: Drift sideways a pace on a breath of qi as thistledown on a draught.

name: Adamantine Knuckleridge
description: Keep the arms low and loose while the qi field alone turns aside what comes at the body.

name: Toxinstud
description: Rap the ring against the back of the opponent's hand as lightly as a breeze to turn their aim.

name: Berserk Brassrim
description: Run a line of hooks across the opponent's open side without once raising a guard.

name: Impenetrable Bandarch
description: Drift out of a blow's path and send a hook back down the line it left empty.

name: Ringspine
description: Lean the field onto the opponent's guard until their raised arms sink and the face opens.

name: Facet Knuckleplate
description: Drive the boss into the opponent's guard with the whole stance open and committed behind it.

name: Lotslab
description: Drift through a series of angles, striking once at each so the opponent never faces the same fist twice.

name: Pitiless Palmbar Ruin
description: Spread the field wide over several breaths and draw it all back into one fist in a single blow.

name: Blazeslab
description: Take the bearing, speak the vow and jab along the line you have sworn to hold.

name: Lightning Ringband
description: Step so the sworn bearing stays unbroken even as the angle of the stance changes.

name: Unrelenting Brassring
description: Hold the fists in the sworn guard and keep the oath unbroken against each blow.

name: Harnessing Haymaker
description: Tap the knuckles on the opponent's forearm to turn them from their own bearing.

name: Inexorable Studplate
description: Read the bearing of an incoming fist and nudge it aside on that very line.

name: Rumbleknuck
description: Throw crosses down the held bearing one after another, the oath renewed with each.

name: Chimestud
description: Receive a blow along its bearing and return a hook swung from the same direction.

name: Fastening Bandarch
description: Bind the opponent's arms along the line of the bearing and hold them as a vow is held.

name: Murk Overhand
description: Show the opponent a false bearing with the shoulders, then strike along the true one.

name: Novaknuck
description: Drive a charged boss along the held bearing into the single seam the guard cannot close.

name: Knuckwrath
description: Link guard, parry, bind and cross in one chain, each link sworn to the one before.

name: Fastening Brawl
description: Hold the opponent upon the bearing within the qi field so they cannot step off the line.

name: Punishing Knuckleridge
description: Join the held bearing to the sworn blow so the field and the fist land as one stroke.

name: Knuckruin
description: Jab across the line of the wind so the blow lands from an angle the opponent did not read.

name: Torrent Handfill
description: Shuffle across the wind with short steps, never facing the opponent's strongest side.

name: Fistbar Mettle
description: Root the stance as if on the plateau's rim and raise the fists against what the wind brings.

name: Toxin Knuckleplate
description: Tap the ring on the opponent's wrist from the side to turn the strike across the wind.

name: Equipoise Palmbar
description: Sweep the outer forearm across an incoming punch and let the wind take it wide.

name: Rumble Brassring
description: Chain hooks that cut across the line of the opponent's guard, each bending a little more.

name: Equipoise Knuckleridge
description: Cut through the space beside a punch and answer with a qi-driven cross.

name: Gyve Haymaker
description: Pin the opponent's arm across their body with both fists and hold it as the wind holds a leaf.

name: Titanic Uppercut
description: Bore the charged boss into the guard from the side where the wind has already opened it.

name: Confluent Ringband
description: Strike from three sides of the wind in turn in a sequence that ends back on the first line.

name: Flashing Uppercut
description: Flash across the wind to the opponent's flank and rend the guard with a field-charged hook.
